models.load_method: pipecat WhisperSTTServiceMLX (mlx-whisper 0.4.3), model id passed literally in hermes_voice.py build_stt(); language EN. Loads from the local HuggingFace cache at process start. Alternative engine in the same code: faster-whisper when HERMES_STT=faster, size from HERMES_WHISPER (default 'small').

models.load_method: pipecat PocketTTSService (pocket-tts 2.1.0) in-process. Voice is a catalog NAME from the pocket-tts package, passed as HERMES_VOICE (reference build: 'azelma'; code default: 'eve'). No separate voice file to obtain — the catalog ships with the package's model download.
models.revision: library-pinned — the pocket-tts pip package downloads at revisions hardcoded in the package: model @ d29db7978e464fb90cb3359ee0c69a273b9142cc, voice embeddings @ e041936c75475d350b405bc870bcf7c22da4e9e6

models.load_method: GLiNER.from_pretrained (gliner 0.2.24) on MPS; the bot extracts spans over partial transcripts with its own label set at threshold 0.5. Repo id overridable via HERMES_GLINER_MODEL.

transformers zero-shot-classification pipeline (transformers 5.21.0, torch 2.14.1) on MPS; one forward pass over the final transcript, no generated tokens. Repo id overridable via HERMES_ENCODER_MODEL.
models.role: safety screen — intent classification (production; advisory to the lane)

models.load_method: sherpa-onnx 2.0.1 KeywordSpotter over the directory in models/sherpa-kws (path overridable via HERMES_WAKE_SHERPA_DIR). Keywords are generated at runtime from HERMES_WAKE_PHRASES — the keywords.txt in the distribution is the stock demo list and is NOT what gets spotted. Detection threshold = 0.05 + 0.4 * HERMES_WAKE_SENSITIVITY (0.29 at the default sensitivity 0.6).
models.revision: not a hub repo — distributed as a fixed release tarball/git repo; no content hash harvested (the reference copy's README identifies it; files below are the reference inventory)
models.role: wake word — open-vocabulary keyword spotting (production, 'sherpa' engine)
models.source: ModelScope git: https://www.modelscope.cn/pkufool/sherpa-onnx-kws-zipformer-gigaspeech-3.3M-2024-01-01.git (the same model is distributed with sherpa-onnx, k2-fsa)

models.load_method: pyopen-wakeword 1.1.0, only when HERMES_WAKE_ENGINE=oww and HERMES_WAKE_MODEL points at the file. remote_models_obtain_access_not_files.access: OpenCode Go subscription API key in env OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY. Reference measurement on this route, 2026-10-27: first-token median 434 ms for glm-5.3-flash vs 1551 ms for deepseek-v4.1-flash — the lane default follows the measurement.
Bearer API_SERVER_KEY — a key the installer generates into the Hermes .env; the Hermes gateway must be running with its API-server platform enabled.
remote_models_obtain_access_not_files.model: hermes-agent (HERMES_WORKER_MODEL) — the Hermes gateway's agent endpoint; the reference profile behind it runs deepseek-v4.1-flash via provider opencode-go
